Question 3
?

Find a vector-valued function r(u,v) that parametrizes the surface defined in Cartesian coordinates as z=(x+y)4.

a
r(u,v)=⟨u,v,u4+v4⟩
b
r(u,v)=⟨u4,v4,u+v⟩
c
r(u,v)=⟨u,v,(u+v)4⟩
d
r(u,v)=⟨u,v,u+v⟩
e
r(u,v)=⟨u,v,u4−v4⟩
Submit
